fields.claim: Size scaling moves a 0.32 cm3 compression gauge to one tube's volume. 052 used 1 cm3 for SiC, which differs by about 6% at m 20. Whether fibre-composite compression follows volume scaling is not established.
fields.needed_to_ground: Tube and coupon strengths of the same laminate.
